name: DrakesRenameItLegacy
description: Automated regression for DrakesRenameItLegacy, forked from DrakesRenameIt's "Drake's RenameIt Test Suite 2.0" (SM-/TC- ids) plus extra config coverage (X-). World-hover-text UI coverage (X-06-UI) is dropped: Legacy has no hover UI. Other players are simulated with play-as (Alice, Bob, Nacho-VIP). Visual / UI / multiplayer checks are in DrakesRenameIt-Manual (shared with the main mod; not yet forked).
